question: Add a new required field AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig to the DataSourceConnection struct in Grafana's datasource API types. DataSourceConnection defines how Grafana connects to backends like Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo. All datasource plugins constructing this struct will break.

directly_broken_files.reason: asConnection() constructs DataSourceConnection{Title, APIGroup, APIVersion, Name, Plugin} without populating AuthConfig. This is the primary conversion path from internal DataSource model to the API type. All datasource types (Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, etc.) flow through this method.

legacyConnectionClientImpl.GetConnectionByUID() constructs DataSourceConnection{APIGroup, APIVersion, Name, Plugin} without AuthConfig. This is the legacy fallback path used when the query.grafana.app API group is unavailable.

Test cases construct DataSourceConnection literals with partial fields (e.g., {Name: "a"}, {Name: "test-uid", APIGroup: "prometheus.datasource.grafana.app", APIVersion: "v0alpha1"}) without AuthConfig. Tests will pass at compile time (named fields) but produce incorrect zero-value AuthConfig in assertions.

Multiple test cases construct DataSourceConnection literals for connectionClientImpl and legacyConnectionClientImpl tests. None include AuthConfig. Test assertions comparing expected vs actual will fail if the production code is updated to populate AuthConfig.

Integration tests for ListConnections() validate JSON output of DataSourceConnection items. JSON expectations do not include AuthConfig field. Tests will fail if AuthConfig is required and serialized.

mockDatasources implements GetConnection() returning *DataSourceConnection and ListConnections() returning *DataSourceConnectionList. Mock returns nil, but the interface signatures depend on the struct type.

generated_files_requiring_regeneration.reason: DeepCopyInto for DataSourceConnection uses *out = *in (shallow copy). If AuthenticationConfig contains pointer or slice fields, this will produce incorrect shallow copies. Must regenerate with deepcopy-gen.
OpenAPI schema for DataSourceConnection only includes title, name, group, version, plugin properties. The new AuthConfig field and its AuthenticationConfig type must be added to the schema.
OpenAPI violation exceptions list references DataSourceConnection. May need updating if the new field introduces new violations.

interface_and_provider_impact.description: DataSourceConnectionProvider interface (ListConnections method) returns *DataSourceConnectionList containing DataSourceConnection items. All implementers must ensure the new AuthConfig field is populated.

DataSourceService embeds DataSourceConnectionProvider. The Service implementation in pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go and FakeDataSourceService in pkg/services/datasources/fakes/ both produce DataSourceConnection items.
FakeDataSourceService.ListConnections() returns empty DataSourceConnectionList. If consumers validate AuthConfig, fake will produce invalid results.

downstream_api_consumers.description: QueryAPIBuilder uses DataSourceConnectionProvider to resolve datasource connections during query routing. The connections field stores the provider, and DataSourceConnectionList is registered as a known API type.
ConnectionClient interface returns *DataSourceConnectionList. Both connectionClientImpl (K8s API client) and legacyConnectionClientImpl consume and produce DataSourceConnection objects.

blast_radius_summary.datasource_backends_affected: All datasource plugins (Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, and every other datasource type) flow through asConnection() in pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go, which is the single conversion point. No individual plugin code constructs DataSourceConnection directly.
